subtitle: How Paper Lab Works
title: A seamless workflow from research draft to publication.

steps.title: Organize sections effortlessly
steps.subtitle: Step 01
body: Break down complex academic reports and research papers into modular, structured sections. Drag and drop chapters or sub-sections to reorder content in seconds.
Focus on crafting compelling content while Paper Lab keeps your document tree neat, organized, and synced.

steps.title: Dual WYSIWYG and LaTeX power
steps.subtitle: Step 02
body: Write intuitively using a rich visual editor with real-time A4 live previews, or drop directly into the Monaco LaTeX editor for fine-grained math formatting.
Enjoy instant compilation, error highlighting, and real-time page rendering as you type.

back.alt: Live A4 preview and Monaco editor background

steps.title: Global Citation Manager
steps.subtitle: Step 03
body: Manage citations, references, and BibTeX entries globally across all your projects. Seamlessly import, auto-format, and cite sources in IEEE, APA, Harvard, and custom journal styles.
Keep your bibliographies perfectly synced and accurately formatted without manual entry.

steps.title: Draw & Export Research-Grade Diagrams
steps.subtitle: Step 04
body: Create vector diagrams, architectural schematics, and high-resolution charts directly inside Paper Lab. Export crisp SVG, PNG, or vector PDF figures ready for academic publishing.
Seamlessly embed your diagrams straight into your document sections without quality loss.
